rows.Title: Invoices when a project phase is approved, not by calendar month
rows.Description: Studios bill per project milestone: an invoice goes out when the client signs off a phase. A month-based invoicing model does not fit how they work.
Quotes: "Three invoices per project, never one at month end." — Dana Holt · Northwind Studio · 2026-09-02 · call `2026-09-02_northwind-studio`
"the client gets an invoice when they approve each phase." — Ravi Shah · Pixel & Pine · 2026-09-09 · call `2026-09-09_pixel-pine`
"By phase. The invoice goes out when the client signs off a phase, not on a date." — Jonas Weber · Brightline · 2026-09-22 · call `2026-09-22_brightline`

rows.Title: Wants to see next month's incoming cash ahead of time
rows.Description: They want to know early what money will arrive in the coming weeks, and from which clients, so they can plan payroll and irregular income. Today they guess with spreadsheets or milestone lists.
Quotes: "Knowing next month. Payroll is on the twenty-fifth. In the first week of the month I want to see what cash comes in before then, and from whom." — Dana Holt · Northwind Studio · 2026-09-02 · call `2026-09-02_northwind-studio`
"A view of next month. I want to see what comes in, by client, before the bank tells me." — Jonas Weber · Brightline · 2026-09-22 · call `2026-09-22_brightline`
"I want one number: what lands in the next thirty days." — Leo Marchetti · Leo Marchetti · 2026-10-01 · call `2026-10-01_leo-marchetti`

rows.Title: Years of invoice history hold them in the old tool
rows.Description: Past invoices sit in an old tool or sheet, and losing or splitting that history nearly stops the switch. Importing history removes the barrier.
Quotes: "Seven years of invoices sit in the old tool. We still pay for it every month only to look things up." — Ravi Shah · Pixel & Pine · 2026-09-09 · call `2026-09-09_pixel-pine`
"If I can not bring them along, my tax history sits in two places." — Leo Marchetti · Leo Marchetti · 2026-10-01 · call `2026-10-01_leo-marchetti`
"Five years of invoices were in it, and I did not want to lose them." — Tomas Lind · Tomas Lind · 2026-10-27 · call `2026-10-27_tomas-lind`

rows.Title: Must sync or export to the accountant's accounting system
rows.Description: Sync with the accountant's tool (Xero, Fortnox) is a hard buying criterion. Without it the accountant retypes invoices, and the answer is no.
Quotes: "Can she get in without a paid seat and pull the numbers into Xero?" — Ravi Shah · Pixel & Pine · 2026-09-09 · call `2026-09-09_pixel-pine`
"Anything we pick has to sync with Xero, or it is a no." — Jonas Weber · Brightline · 2026-09-22 · call `2026-09-22_brightline`
"asked me to pick a tool that exports to Fortnox, so she stops typing my invoices in." — Tomas Lind · Tomas Lind · 2026-10-27 · call `2026-10-27_tomas-lind`

rows.Title: Chases late payers by hand
rows.Description: Late payment is chased manually, by phone or a reluctant email, because reminders are ignored or uncomfortable to send.
Quotes: "When a publisher is late, I wait two more weeks before I dare to write." — Hana Okafor · Hana Okafor · 2026-09-15 · call `2026-09-15_hana-okafor`
"Open invoices and the milestones that should close. Then I call the slow clients." — Dana Holt · Northwind Studio · 2026-10-20 · call `2026-10-20_northwind-studio`

rows.Title: Retypes tracked hours into invoices
rows.Description: Hours tracked in a time tool (Harvest, Toggl) are copied into invoices by hand, which costs time every cycle.
Quotes: "Every month somebody retypes them into the invoices. It takes a full afternoon." — Jonas Weber · Brightline · 2026-09-22 · call `2026-09-22_brightline`
"I track hours in Toggl and copy them into each invoice by hand." — Tomas Lind · Tomas Lind · 2026-10-27 · call `2026-10-27_tomas-lind`

rows.Title: Unsure which VAT text to put on invoices to foreign clients
rows.Description: Cross-border invoices need the right VAT or reverse-charge wording, and the app gives no help. They want it added from the client's country.
Quotes: "I never know which VAT text to put on the invoice, and the app does not tell me." — Hana Okafor · Hana Okafor · 2026-09-15 · call `2026-09-15_hana-okafor`
"I pick the client's country, and the app puts the right VAT text on the invoice." — Tomas Lind · Tomas Lind · 2026-10-27 · call `2026-10-27_tomas-lind`

rows.Title: The invoice must look professional and on-brand
rows.Description: The invoice is the last thing a client sees, so it reflects on their work. A generic invoice feels cheap; they want their own font and layout.
Quotes: "If it looks cheap, my cover looks cheap." — Hana Okafor · Hana Okafor · 2026-09-15 · call `2026-09-15_hana-okafor`
"The invoice is the last thing a client sees from us after six months of work. It has to look like us." — Dana Holt · Northwind Studio · 2026-10-20 · call `2026-10-20_northwind-studio`

rows.Title: A late client sign-off throws off the cash plan
rows.Description: Because invoices wait for phase sign-off, one late approval moves incoming cash and forces manual juggling. It explains why the forecast is a guess.
Quotes: "I look at which milestones should close and hope the clients sign them off on time." — Dana Holt · Northwind Studio · 2026-09-02 · call `2026-09-02_northwind-studio`
"We have eleven salaries. One late phase sign-off and I move money around for a week." — Jonas Weber · Brightline · 2026-09-22 · call `2026-09-22_brightline`

rows.Title: Accountant gets into the data without a paid seat
rows.Description: They want the accountant to log in and take the invoices herself instead of a manual hand-off. It can decide the purchase and remove price objections.
Quotes: "Can she get in without a paid seat and pull the numbers into Xero?" — Ravi Shah · Pixel & Pine · 2026-09-09 · call `2026-09-09_pixel-pine`
"If she could log in herself, I would not think twice about the price." — Hana Okafor · Hana Okafor · 2026-09-15 · call `2026-09-15_hana-okafor`

rows.Title: Builds each milestone invoice by hand
rows.Description: With no milestone billing in the app, each phase invoice is copied and edited or made manually. A prompt or auto-invoice on phase close removes this work.
Quotes: "I copy the last invoice, change the milestone line and send it by hand." — Dana Holt · Northwind Studio · 2026-09-02 · call `2026-09-02_northwind-studio`
"Nothing in the app knows that phase three closed." — Ravi Shah · Pixel & Pine · 2026-09-09 · call `2026-09-09_pixel-pine`
